text.p: Gandalf Technologies Inc and Samsung Electronics Co said on Tuesday they signed a formal memorandum of understanding for a partnership enabling Samsung to distribute Gandalf products for Korea's networking market.
The agreement also allows for a joint development between the two companies for the remote access market.
Financial details of the deal were not disclosed.
Gandalf said the MOU encompasses both distribution and cross licensing of each company's technology.

Beginning immediately, Samsung will distribute and support Gandalf's Xpress family of remote access and concentration products to VARs and resellers throughout Korea. Gandalf said the MOU will allow Samsung to benefit from Gandalf's industry-leading compression and encryption technologies, and Gandalf to benefit from Samsung's leading switching technologies.

The deal was signed as part of the Team Canada trade mission to Korea, which is currently underway. The team, led by Prime Minister Jean Chretien, includes representatives from over 300 Canadian companies.
